title: MCP Protocol Correctness
description: Verifies protocol compliance and behavioral correctness per MCP specification

checks.title: Initialize handshake completes
checks.description: Server responds to initialize with valid capabilities

checks.title: Tool listing returns valid schema
checks.description: tools/list returns array of tools with valid JSON Schema definitions

checks.title: Resource listing returns valid data
checks.description: resources/list returns properly formatted resources (if capability advertised)

checks.title: Prompt listing returns valid data
checks.description: prompts/list returns properly formatted prompts (if capability advertised)

checks.title: Response schemas validate
checks.description: All responses conform to MCP JSON-RPC schema

checks.title: Errors use JSON-RPC error format
checks.description: Error responses include code, message, and optional data

checks.title: Requests timeout gracefully
checks.description: Long-running requests can be cancelled; server doesn't hang indefinitely

checks.title: Stdio reconnect works cleanly
checks.description: After server restart, client can re-initialize without corruption

checks.title: SSE reconnect works cleanly
checks.description: After connection drop, SSE client can reconnect and resume

checks.title: Responses are deterministic or explicitly nondeterministic
checks.description: Same input produces same output, or tool declares nondeterminism

checks.title: Advertised capabilities match behavior
checks.description: Server only advertises capabilities it actually implements
